```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

This will download the SERT sequences for human and zebrafish respectively and create a reference fasta file 

```{bash}
curl -fsSLG \
  "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi" \
  --data-urlencode "db=protein" \
  --data-urlencode "id=CAA50029.1,ABB88575.1" \
  --data-urlencode "rettype=fasta" \
  --data-urlencode "retmode=text" \
  -o ../data/reference_sert.fasta
```

Check if that fasta file we created was populated correctly

```{bash}
head ../data/reference_sert.fasta
```

Download the predicted amino acid sequences for SERT in chinook salmon that are labeled as serotonin transporter on NCBI

```{bash}
curl -fsSLG \
  "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi" \
  --data-urlencode "db=protein" \
  --data-urlencode "id=XP_042153127.1,XP_042153126.1, XP_042153125.1, XP_042151900.1, XP_042151899.1, XP_042151898.1" \
  --data-urlencode "rettype=fasta" \
  --data-urlencode "retmode=text" \
  -o ../data/chinook_sert.fasta
```


```{bash}
head ../data/chinook_sert.fasta
```

```{bash}
/Users/valeste/miniconda3/envs/blast/bin/makeblastdb \
  -in ../data/reference_sert.fasta \
  -dbtype prot \
  -out ../data/reference_sert_db
```

```{bash}
/Users/valeste/miniconda3/envs/blast/bin/blastp \
  -query ../data/chinook_sert.fasta \
  -db ../data/reference_sert_db \
  -out ../output/chinook_sert_blastp.tsv \
  -evalue 1e-5 \
  -max_target_seqs 20 \
  -outfmt "6 qseqid sseqid pident length qlen slen qcovs evalue bitscore"
```


```{r}
library(readr)

# Read BLASTP results
blast_results <- read_tsv(
  "../output/chinook_sert_blastp.tsv",
  col_names = c(
    "query_id", "subject_id", "percent_identity",
    "alignment_length", "query_length", "subject_length",
    "query_coverage", "evalue", "bitscore"
  )
)

# View dataframe
View(blast_results)

# Export as CSV
write_csv(blast_results, "../output/chinook_sert_blastp.csv")
```
